title: Global HR Operations Associate - Contingent Workforce
description: Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. What You'll Do BCG’s central Contingent Workforce team, branded as Contingent IQ, supports the engagement and onboarding of contingent workers and client-facing contractors across BCG. Together with the Global HR Shared Services Center (HRSSC) function that supports the internal employee lifecycle and operations, we are enhancing every individual’s journey at BCG. The HR Operations Associate will be supporting the back-end processing of contingent worker requests. This role is responsible for coordinating and executing operational activities across onboarding, supplier registration, system processing, renewals, and offboarding, while helping ensure that requests are handled accurately, compliantly, and in a timely manner. Key role & responsibilities Daily management of operational activities supporting contingent worker and client-facing contractor onboarding Reviewing intake information to ensure requests are complete, accurate, and aligned to the correct process path Completing required activities in operational systems and tools, including supplier onboarding and requisition-related support in Coupa. Capturing, validating, and maintaining accurate supplier, contract, stakeholder, and service-related information across systems, trackers, and supporting documentation. Monitoring shared mailboxes, trackers, and operational queues to ensure timely and accurate case progression. Responding to operational queries from stakeholders and providing clear status updates on active requests. Maintaining strong data integrity across relevant systems and identifying gaps, errors, or missing information for follow-up. Maintaining personnel records in compliance with legal requirements and internal standards. Producing basic reports and responding to data or status requests from key stakeholders and supporting internal audits with required documentation and timely response. What You'll Bring A Graduate degree or equivalent. 1-3 years of experience in HR operations, contingent workforce operations, shared services, stakeholder operations, procurement coordination, or a related operational environment. Ability to work flexible hours, as needed, to provide effective global coverage. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Proficiency in MS Office, especially Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint. Experience working in a global multinational is preferred. Demonstrated integrity, professionalism, and a strong service mindset. Desirable: Basic experience with contingent workforce processes, supplier onboarding, contractor lifecycle operations, shared mailboxes, service management, Coupa, Workday, Fieldglass, or related tools. Additional info This role requires someone who thrives in a structured, matrixed global organization and can manage detail-heavy operational work while collaborating across teams: Work effectively within a global, cross-cultural, and virtual environment. Demonstrate a strong customer focus and effective stakeholder management skills. Exhibit exceptional attention to detail and a disciplined approach to operational accuracy. Communicate clearly and professionally with a range of stakeholders across teams and functions. Thriving under pressure with exceptional attention to detail. Staying flexible and reliable in a dynamic and changing environment. Handling sensitive data with confidentiality and professionalism. At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development. For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices. We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
